description:
Manage tasks stored as TASK:/DONE: anchor lines inside notes and logs. Turn ACTION: lines into anchors, then change those anchors by uuid.

Subcommands:
  ingest [--dry-run] [--quiet] — rewrite every ACTION: line in notes and logs into a TASK anchor with a new 8-char uuid (same as calling tasks with no subcommand)
  add THREAD TEXT [--due DATE] [--scheduled DATE] [--priority P] [--depends UUID] — queue an ACTION in the buffer (same as buffer add-action)
  done UUID — mark complete: rewrites TASK to DONE and stamps the end date as today
  set-description UUID TEXT — replace the task body
  set-assignee UUID PERSON — replace the (Assignee) prefix
  set-due UUID DATE — set the due date
  set-scheduled UUID DATE — set the scheduled date
  set-priority UUID PRIORITY — set priority to H, M or L
  add-depends UUID DEP_UUID — make the task wait on DEP_UUID
  rm-depends UUID DEP_UUID — remove a dependency
  list [--priority P] [--thread T] [--assignee A] [--overdue] [--json] — pending tasks grouped by thread (A-Z), then sorted by priority, due and entry
  next — top 5 pending tasks by priority, due and entry
  show UUID — show the details of one task

Args:
  UUID  the task uuid from list; any unique prefix works
  DATE  YYYY-MM-DD
  PERSON  a name with a file people/<name>.md; a leading people/ is allowed
  DEP_UUID  add-depends: unique prefix of the task this one waits on. rm-depends: prefix that matches one of this task's dependencies

Flags:
  top-level and ingest: --dry-run shows what would be ingested and writes nothing; --quiet suppresses per-action output. Put top-level flags before the subcommand.
  add: THREAD is 'Kind/Name', e.g. Projects/SGB. TEXT is '(Assignee) description' or 'description'. --due DATE, --scheduled DATE, --priority H|M|L, --depends UUID (8-char uuid; repeat the flag for more than one).
  list: --priority H|M|L; --thread Kind/Name; --assignee NAME; --overdue shows only tasks due before today; --json gives JSON output.

Examples:
  ["list", "--overdue", "--json"]
  ["add", "Projects/SGB", "(Charlie) Review the contract", "--due", "2026-10-15", "--priority", "H"]
  ["done", "abcd1234"]
  ["set-due", "abcd1234", "2026-10-15"]

Notes:
  add does not create a task. It queues an ACTION in the buffer. A uuid exists only after buffer flush, then ingest. Every notes subcommand except new also runs ingest.
  ingest, done, set-*, add-depends and rm-depends rewrite the source note or log in place. Never edit anchors by hand.
  Exit 1: no task matches the uuid prefix, empty prefix, bad date, empty description, person does not resolve, or a task made to depend on itself.
